description.zh: 命名空间。在同时填写命名空间和服务账号时生效，否则将被忽略。
description.en: The namespace. This parameter takes effect only when both the namespace and the service account are specified. Otherwise, it is ignored.

description.zh: 服务账号。在同时填写命名空间和服务账号时生效，否则将被忽略。
description.en: The service account. This parameter takes effect only when both the namespace and the service account are specified. Otherwise, it is ignored.
The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

description.zh: 信任域。在同时填写命名空间和服务账号时，默认值为cluster.local；否则将被忽略。
description.en: The trust domain. If both the namespace and the service account are specified, the default value is cluster.local. Otherwise, this parameter is ignored.

title.zh: 获取VM网格化所需的元数据信息
title.en: Obtains the metadata required for adding a VM to the mesh.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh get-vm-meta --service-mesh-id ce51a7de4a5144db88a864ed910000 --trust-domain cluster.local --namespace hello --service-account http-sa --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh GetVmMeta --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceAccount 'http-sa' --TrustDomain 'cluster.local' --ServiceMeshId ce51a7de4a5144db88a864ed910000 --Namespace hello
